**Construction Management** is an active **Bachelor of Technology degree-completion program** in BCIT’s School of Construction and the Environment.

- **Format:** Full-time or part-time
- **Delivery:** In person at Burnaby
- **Focus:** Construction-project management, technical knowledge, organizational leadership, stakeholder engagement, and professional communication
- **Curriculum:** Required construction and management courses, at least **4 credits from the approved management-elective pool**, and **12 Liberal Studies credits**
- **Final project:** Complete **CMGT 8700 – Industry Based Project Proposal**, then choose either **CMGT 8800 – Industry Based Project** or **CMGT 8810 – Industry Based Project**, subject to department approval

Admission requires an approved pre-entry assessment, English Studies 12 at 73% or equivalent, and exactly one of four entry pathways based on construction-related education, other post-secondary education with bridging or experience, or an approved Red Seal trade.

[Construction Management program page](https://www.bcit.ca/programs/construction-management-bachelor-of-technology-full-time-part-time-8800btech/)
